label.enterToken: Enter an API token to load the workspaces

tip.token: Create a token in Datacake under Account Settings → API Token, or better use an API user with limited permissions (Members → API Users).
tip.migrated: The API token was stored in plain text in the flow file. It now moves to the encrypted credentials, deploy to complete the change.

migration.notice: __count__ Datacake account(s) store the API token in plain text in the flow file.
migration.done: API token moved to the encrypted credentials. Deploy to save the change.
